notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.6 (December, 15)
notes.content:
IN CASE YOU DON'T GET THE UPDATE, UNINSTALL AND RE-INSTALL.
[b][u]
Problem solved :[/u][/b]

- No white screen anymore
- Quetzalcoatlus & Pteranodon correctly sleeping on adult map.

[i]Removal of the Winter map (VR issues).[/i]

[b][u]News (only on adult map):[/u][/b]

- Graphic improvement
- New variety of rocks
- more dinosaurs (now around 300)
- Underwater exploration (accessible from adult map, underwater hole, press the thumbstick to get the pointer and launch)
- New species, total different species available : 31
- Tour Train : Relaxing train tour of a part of the adult map, nice landscape, nice natural sounds and if you get lucky, some dinosaurs (each tour will be different because the dinosaurs do whatever they want so sometimes they are not close to the train)
- Dino Coaster : A completly crazy RollerCoaster around the island.
[u][b]
Known issues :[/b][/u]


- the branch to feed herbivorous can be transparent.


[u][b]Next update : 1.0.6.2, planned for early in january 2019.[/b][/u]

[u]Features coming for the next update : [/u]

- Fixing known issues
- Ride the Giant QuetzalCoatlus
- Information panel for Mosasaurus, Ichthyosaurus, Onchopristis, Archelon, Ammonite, Sarcosuchus.


[i]Last thing, which will come probably later : HTC Vive compatibility (hopefully before the end of january).[/i]
